## Summary

Added a live-reload dev server to the SSG:

- **`src/devServer.ts`** (new) — `startDevServer()` builds the site, starts an HTTP server serving `./dist` with a live-reload `<script>` injected before `</body>` in HTML responses, starts a `ws` WebSocket server at `/__livereload`, and watches `content/`/`templates/` with `chokidar` (debounced rebuild + broadcast `"reload"` to connected clients on change).
- **`src/cli.ts`** — new `serve` command (`--content`, `--output`, `--templates`, `--port`, default 3000), leaves `build` untouched.
- **`src/index.ts`** — exports `startDevServer`/`injectLiveReload`.
- **`package.json`** — added `chokidar` + `ws` deps, `@types/ws` dev dep.
- **`tests/devServer.test.ts`** (new) — 7 tests covering script injection, static asset serving, 404s, and rebuild+reload on both content and template changes.

Verified with a manual smoke test against the real `templates/` directory (curl + a live WebSocket client) that editing a markdown file triggers rebuild and a `reload` push, and that `npm run build` still compiles cleanly.
